description_en: This three-tiered south-facing temple is located in Dupāḥ Ṭola and is attached to the Dupāḥ Capāḥ (LAL4076). A stone image of Gaṇeśa is housed in the sanctum of the temple. The sanctum's entrance is clad in brass and topped with a brasstoraṇathat was donated in NS 1014 (1894). Images of Bhairava, Mātṛkā and Gaṇeśa have been carved into the temple's struts, and a gilded pinnacle flanked by two metal flags can be found atop the building. A metal banner (patāḥ) hangs from the pinnacle and reaches as far down as thetoraṇa.All three tiers of the temple are finished in copper sheets. Twenty carved struts support the lowest roof whilst twelve similar struts support the middle and the upper roofs. The first and the second floors are divided by four layers of timber cornice and projectinglhākay.There are four carved windows in the first floor.This temple was reconstructed in 2008 with the financial support of Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City and the active involvement of local people.
description_ne: दुपाः टोलबाट सःक्व तिर लाग्ने बाटो छेउमा यो मन्दिर अवस्थित छ । तीनले दक्षिणाभिमुख मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा शिलाको गणेश मूर्ति रहेको छ । मन्दिरको ढोका अगाडि एक जोडा सिंहमूर्ति स्थापित छ । गर्भगृह प्रवेश गर्ने ढोकालाई पित्तलको पाताले मोडी सजाइएको छ भने ढोकामाथि नेसं १०१४ मा चढाइएको पित्तलकै तोरण देख्न सकिन्छ । मन्दिरका टुँडालहरूमा भैरव, मातृका एवं गणेशका मूर्तिहरू कुँदिएका छन् । मन्दिरका तीनै छानाहरू तामाको पाताले छाइएको छ । छानामाथि सुनौलो लेप लगाइएको गजुर र दायाँ–बायाँ दुई ध्वजाहरू खडा गरिएको देख्न सकिन्छ । गजुरदेखि तल्लो छानोसम्म तामाको पताः लत्रिएको छ ।मन्दिरमा भएका टुँडालहरूको तल्लो भागमा दाताका नाम र संवत् ८१८ कुँदिएको पाइएको छ । उक्त अभिलेखले मन्दिर निर्माण समय बुझाउन खोजेको हो वा मन्दिर जीर्णोद्धार गरी नयाँ टुँडाल चढाइएको समयलाई बुझाउन खोजेको हो स्पष्ट छैन । जीर्ण बन्दै गएपछि ललितपुर उपमहानगरपालिका र दुपाःटोलवासीको सक्रियतामा विसं २०६४ मा यस मन्दिरको जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो ।स्थानगणेशकारूपमापूजिनेयसमन्दिरकोवर्षवर्धनपूजापहिले हुने गरेको तर अहिले बन्दभैसकेकोकुरास्थानीय वृद्धहरूबताउँछन्।गर्भगृमारहेकोशिलाकोगणेशमूर्तिकोसमान आकृति आकृति भएको तामाकोमूर्तिस्थानीयमहर्जनखलककोसंग्रहमारहेकोछ।उक्तमूर्तिलाईइन्द्रजात्राकोसमयमन्दिरकोगर्भगृहमाराखीप्रदर्शनगर्नेपरम्पराचल्दैआएकोछ।
monument_assessment: Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)

historical_events.event_description: An inscription on a strut supporting the lower story on the western side of the temple records that Hākurāma donated the strut on the mentioned date. It may have been that he donated the strut during the reconstruction of the temple.
Nine members of the Dāphā Khalaḥdonated thetoraṇa.
Gumiṃ Siṃha, Bhāvo Abhi Siṃha, Panu Siṃha and Herāma Ralakesa reconstructed the temple.
Viṣṇu Maharjan, grandson of Bekhāsĩ and son of Bekhālāla, donated the brasstoraṇawhich is fixed on top of the image of Gaṇeśa with his wife Nānī and son Āśisa.
Paridhara Jyāpu, Kīsalakṣmī, Dhimāsī, Pasīmuni and Kṛṣṇalāla donated the bell that hangs in front of the temple.

historical_events.event_name: Installation of a stone toraṇa and formation of a group of devotees
historical_events.event_description: Vijarāja Vajrācārya (of Guru Bāhāla) formed theGaṇeśaSevā(probablyKhalaḥ, which means a group of devotees). Gvamirāja was thethakāli,and the other group members were: Vijasiña, Jagarāma, Yandrarā, Gumisiña, Asiña, Jñokita, Tethā, Manisiña, Gumirāma, Hākusiña, Suṣudeva,  Suṣucā,  Silāma, Mālasiña, Madhasiña Kihima(Kimhi)siña and Amirāja, among others. The inscription also records that a group was formed to acceptYināya Mataor the Gaṇeśa flame (probably butter lamps), with the people named in the inscription as its members. The team installed a stonetoraṇaover the entrance of the Gaṇeśa shrine in the temple. A special worship calleddahrūwas performed on the same day one year later.

historical_events.event_name: The lower and middle copper roofs were fixed

historical_events.event_description: Lalitapur Sub-Metropolitan City, Sanāḥ Guthi and Ṭola Sudhāra Samiti renovated the temple.
Pāṇḍva, Dīpaka and Lakṣmī donated a bronzepatāḥto Gaṇeśa.

historical_events.event_name: An institution of devotees (Sakebāra Sevā) was formed and two images of lions were installed
historical_events.event_description: The inscription records two events: one is the formation of thesakebāra sevā,a group performing certain activities in honor of Gaṇeśa, and the other is the installation of two images of lions in the Bāhāḥ or Dupātṭola. Fortunately, the date is very clear.Thesakebāra sevāconsisted of ten people; this was agroup of devotees that performed certain activities on Tuesdays in honor of the localGaṇeśaand installed two images ofsiṃbāhāna(likely two lion statues). Some of the names mentioned are Mādhava Siṃha Bhāvo, Māla Siṃha Bhāvo, Hari (Siṃha??) Bhāvo and Bābu Deva Bhāvo. The leader of these ten men appears to be Biṣṇu Siṃha Bhāvo. It is clear that ten people of the Bhāvo (Jyāpu) community were involved in the event.
